requirements.description: User registration, scholar certification, profile editing, and display of achievements and cooperation networks.
Literature retrieval across multiple dimensions, conversational/natural-language search, semantic correction, multilingual support, filtering, and sorting.
Academic interaction including moderated comments, Q&A, encrypted 1-to-1 private messaging with mutual verification, following, annotations, and sharing.
Academic achievement management, hierarchical field classification, claim verification, and multi-stage claim appeal workflow.
Institution membership and creation workflows, administrative review, and three-level institution hierarchy (university, institute, laboratory).
Periodic data collection via crawlers/APIs, deduplication/cleaning, daily incremental sync, hotspot analysis, and influence profiles.
Personalized content and literature recommendations, including interdisciplinary diversity rules.
Access control for unpublished works, 3-month delayed disclosure for sensitive rankings, encrypted messaging, and AES-256 data protection.
Persistent hybrid storage for relational and unstructured data, with daily full and hourly incremental backups kept for 30 days.
Academic misconduct detection via draft plagiarism checking and blacklist filtering.
Three-tier architecture separating application layer, support services layer, and infrastructure layer.

components.name: API Gateway & Security Controller
components.description: Handles authentication verification, route dispatching, rate limiting, and access authorization for sensitive or unpublished data.

components.name: User and Scholar Profile Service
components.description: Manages user registrations, scholar certification workflows, profile updates, and displays scholar networks.

components.name: Academic Collaboration & Messaging Service
components.description: Provides moderated commenting, literature Q&A, collaborative annotations, and end-to-end verified point-to-point private messaging.

components.name: Conversational Search & Translation Gateway
components.description: Processes natural language queries, multi-turn conversational search contexts, and multilingual translation for literature queries.

components.name: Institution Hierarchy Management Service
components.description: Manages application workflows and models the 3-level tree structure (university, institute, laboratory).

components.name: Achievement & Claim Lifecycle Service
components.description: Manages multi-level academic taxonomies, author achievement claims, and three-stage appeal verification processes.

components.name: Multilingual Semantic Search Engine
components.description: Executes multidimensional retrieval, semantic error correction, and cross-language mappings across Chinese, English, Japanese, and German.

components.name: Recommendation & Discovery Engine
components.description: Generates personalized literature feeds and triggers diversity rules to recommend cross-disciplinary researchers.

components.name: Hotspot & Influence Analytics Engine
components.description: Computes research hotspots, compiles influence profiles, and enforces embargo rules on sensitive metric disclosure.

components.name: Academic Misconduct Detection Service
components.description: Performs draft plagiarism checks and cross-references blacklist records against submissions.

components.name: Data Collection & ETL Pipeline
components.description: Crawls and accesses external scholarly APIs, deduplicates, cleans, and coordinates daily incremental synchronizations.

components.name: Secure Hybrid Persistence Layer
components.description: Provides encrypted persistent storage (AES-256) for relational operational models and unstructured literature and behavior logs.

components.name: Automated Backup & Retention System
components.description: Executes daily full backups and hourly incremental backups with a 30-day retention lifecycle.

connectors.description: Routes user authentication, profile requests, and scholar verification actions.
Directs conversational search queries and filter parameters.
Transfers comment submissions, questions, and mutual-verification private messaging sessions.
Queries and associates scholar profiles with institutional nodes in the hierarchy.
Dispatches parsed search terms and conversational contexts for semantic retrieval.
Passes user query patterns to inform cross-disciplinary recommendation diversity rules.
Verifies literature and achievement bindings for commentary, annotations, and Q&A.
Triggers plagiarism checks and blacklist validations on claimed or submitted drafts.
Feeds synchronized and cleaned academic data for hotspot computation and influence scoring.
Persists structured and unstructured academic data into storage.
Stores and reads achievement classifications, claims, and status records with AES-256 encryption.
Stores computed metrics and reads aggregated academic records.
Queries index and unstructured literature corpora for search and filtering.
Supplies database dumps and transaction logs for hourly incremental and daily full backups.
